descriptionChirho: The active verbal action of singing, whether in Qal or Piel stem, across all finite conjugations (perfect, imperfect, cohortative, consecutive) and infinitive construct forms.

Substantivized participle (both Qal and Piel, masculine and feminine) designating a person whose role is singing, especially the Levitical temple singers in Chronicles, Ezra, and Nehemiah, including prepositional phrases referring to them.
Hofal (causative passive) stem indicating something that is or will be sung, i.e., the passive reception of the action of singing.
